VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence confirms criterion (2) — all 23 tests pass per the CI log. However, criterion (1), "the bug is fixed," is not actually substantiated by the provided evidence. A passing test suite only proves the bug is fixed if a test specifically reproduces the stale-quote eviction bug and now passes. There is no diff, no description of the root cause and fix, and no indication that a new (or previously failing) regression test covers the eviction logic. The self-report and a green build are consistent with a fix, but they're equally consistent with the bug not being covered by any test at all. Without verifying that a test actually exercises the stale-quote eviction path, the first criterion is unconfirmed.
